tasks.detail: Fast AST → docs/graph/codebase-graph.json + codebase-map.md → Redis cache → smoke (fast-ast + KAG synthetic). ~10s, no LLM, no GPU.

tasks.label: 🔎 Graphify: Semantic Index (Qdrant codebase_chunks_768)
tasks.detail: EmbeddingGemma → Qdrant codebase_chunks_768 → smoke:ace verification. Slower (embedding pass), enables semantic search and ACE retrieval.

tasks.label: 🧠 Graphify: Full ACE Index (daily + semantic + topology)
tasks.detail: Full stack refresh: fast AST + EmbeddingGemma + hypergraph topology + smoke:ace:full (14 gates). Use weekly or before deploys.

tasks.label: 🏭 Graphify: Full GPU + TurboQuant
tasks.detail: Heavy: starts TurboQuant (:8090) + runs full GPU production-readiness pipeline (SOM BMU, hypergraph, PageRank, Neo4j, Gemma4 plans). Hour+ runtime.

tasks.label: ✅ Graphify: 5-Pillar Smoke
tasks.detail: Verify all 5 Graphify pillars: fast AST graph, Redis cache, KAG wiki notes, Qdrant semantic index, ACE fallback contract. ~3s. Use --strict to fail on any absent pillar.

tasks.label: 📈 Graphify: Analyze → next_steps plan
tasks.detail: Read codebase-graph.json + hypergraph-clusters.json, cross-correlate gate failures with hypergraph clusters, write next_steps/active/<date>-graph-analysis.md with prioritized findings. ~3s, no LLM.

tasks.label: 📊 Graphify: Live Progress (latest log)
tasks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$latest = Get-ChildItem logs/task-output/graphify-full-*.log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $latest) { Write-Host 'No graphify-full log yet — run graphify:full first' -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 }; Write-Host \"Log: $($latest.FullName)\" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host \"Size: $([math]::Round($latest.Length/1KB,1)) KB, modified $($latest.LastWriteTime)\" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '---'; $content = Get-Content $latest.FullName -Raw; $matches = [regex]::Matches($content, 'Progress: (\d+)% \((\d+) indexed, (\d+) cached, (\d+) errors\)'); if ($matches.Count -gt 0) { $last = $matches[$matches.Count-1]; Write-Host \"Latest: $($last.Value)\" -ForegroundColor Green; if ($matches.Count -gt 5) { $first = $matches[0]; $rate = ([int]$last.Groups[2].Value - [int]$first.Groups[2].Value); Write-Host \"Indexed delta since first sample: $rate chunks\" -ForegroundColor Cyan } } else { Write-Host 'No progress lines (job may have finished or failed)' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host '---'; Write-Host 'Tail (last 15 non-progress lines):' -ForegroundColor Cyan; (Get-Content $latest.FullName) | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'Progress:' } | Select-Object -Last 15"
tasks.detail: Read latest logs/task-output/graphify-full-*.log — show progress %, chunks indexed, and last 15 non-progress lines. Use during long graphify:full runs to check status without blocking.

tasks.label: 📖 Open ACE/KAG/Gemma4 how-to guide
tasks.detail: Open docs/ace-kag-howto.md — operator's manual for fast AST → Redis KAG → Gemma4 → ACE workflows, all VS Code tasks, npm scripts, and troubleshooting.

tasks.label: 🤖 Agent: Batch Error Fix — Dry Run (list hotspots)
tasks.detail: List the top-N audit hotspot directories from codebase-graph.json without dispatching to the agent. Safe to run anytime — no dev server needed.

tasks.label: 🤖 Agent: Batch Error Fix — Parallel (top-N hotspots → fix plans)
tasks.detail: Fan out top-N audit hotspots from codebase-graph.json to /api/ai/agent/batch (SSE). Runs Gemma4 agent loops in parallel (default 3-way) — one fix plan per directory. Plans written to next_steps/active/{date}/batch-fix-{ts}/. Requires dev server on :5173.

tasks.label: 🤖 Agent: Batch Error Fix — Quiet (logs/task-output)
tasks.detail: Same as parallel batch fix, but redirects all output to logs/task-output/agent-batch-fix-latest.log. Terminal shows only the last 40 lines (summary). Plans still written to next_steps/active/. Use this when running large topN to avoid VS Code chat buffer overflow.

tasks.label: 🗺️ Graphify: Daily Map (fast AST + smoke)
tasks.detail: Layer 1 — fast AST indexer (no GPU, no dev server) + smoke-fast-ast + smoke-kag. Refreshes docs/graph/codebase-graph.json + Redis code:index:* + wiki:note:dir:* in ~3-5s. Run this every morning.

tasks.label: 🔎 Graphify: Semantic Index (Qdrant + ACE smoke)
tasks.detail: Layer 2 — codebase-semantic-indexer (EmbeddingGemma 768-dim → Qdrant codebase_chunks_768) + ACE smoke. Run after big code changes. Requires Qdrant on :6333 and EmbeddingGemma reachable.

tasks.label: 🧠 Graphify: Full ACE Index (daily + semantic + hypergraph)
tasks.detail: Full pipeline — daily map + Qdrant semantic + hypergraph build (Redis-backed) + ACE full smoke. Takes ~2-5 min. Use before a big agent run or production-readiness audit.

tasks.label: 🏭 Graphify: Full GPU + TurboQuant
tasks.detail: Layer 3 — start TurboQuant detached + full GPU production-readiness (SOM BMU + hypergraph + PageRank + Neo4j + cluster synthesis + ACE plans). Heavy (~5-10 min, RTX 3060 Ti). Output: next_steps/active/.

tasks.label: 🩺 Graphify: Smoke (5-pillar health check)
tasks.detail: Read-only health check across all 5 Graphify pillars: graph JSON, codebase-map.md, Redis fast cache + KAG notes, Qdrant codebase_chunks_768, ACE FAST_AST_SCORE_CAP. Use --no-redis or --no-qdrant to skip service-dependent pillars.

tasks.label: 📚 Graphify: Cluster Digest (per-centroid topic + members)
tasks.detail: Join hypergraph k-means assignments + Qdrant payloads → docs/graph/hypergraph-clusters.{md,json}. Pure aggregation (no LLM). Each cluster gets: inferredTopic, topKinds, topTags, topSymbols, topPaths, memberFiles. Requires hypergraph:build:redis to have run first. ~1-2s for K=100 / 32k vectors.

tasks.label: 🤖 Graphify: Write AGENTS.md per directory
tasks.detail: Synthesize one AGENTS.md per non-trivial directory from codebase-graph.json + hypergraph-clusters.json + Redis wiki:note:dir:* KAG notes. Files include: purpose, audit score, file list, hypergraph cluster topic + tags, agentic tool-calling examples (graph_search/wiki_note_lookup/audit_hotspots/read_file). Idempotent: human-edited files (no AGENTS-GEN marker) are preserved. ~249 files generated. Use --dry-run/--filter for partial regen.

tasks.label: 🤖 Graphify: AGENTS.md (dry-run preview)
tasks.detail: Preview which AGENTS.md files would be written (no file IO). Shows KAG-enriched vs graph-only flag per dir. Safe to run anytime.
